# T-1: Classify failed regression

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Extend final-regression failure classification and artifact evidence so failures expose Issue #403 categories, assertion/execution nature, current diff relationship, freshness evidence, fixAttempts, and eligibility for record-and-proceed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Artifacts expose the category, relationship, command identity, changed-file fingerprints, and fixAttempts fields required by R1 through R5 and R7.
- Current-diff and workflow-integrity failures are not eligible for record-and-proceed.
- Existing pass/skipped/current-diff behavior remains covered.

## Implementation Notes
Work primarily in run-final-regression.js and test-artifacts.js. Use dedicated classes or class extensions for meaningful classification, stale-check, fix-attempt, and proceed evidence.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for classification mapping, eligibility boundaries, artifact validation, and fail-closed cases.
